hypothesis: A native-resolution lidar scarp-geometry field (amplitude/SNR, coherence, cross-resolution replication) carries hidden fault geometry that the mapped catalogue misses, and blue-noise placement on its top cells can beat the owner-reported champion on the same dot budget.
mechanism: 2 m working-resolution lidar scarp aggregates at 100 m, percentile-ranked inside the eligible domain (lidar-covered, off-catalogue by 3 px, cultural mask), then greedy 1.5 px blue-noise selection of the highest-ranked cells; no catalogue-distance feature is used anywhere in the surface.
non_fault_mimic: range-front fan-head incision and terrace risers: local relief raises every scarp channel without faulting. Measured twice - the interior/range-front block stratification and the 8-relief x 4-slope terrain-matched control.

surface.rationale: amp_snr = sqrt(ex_max * ex_mean) is the lane's SNR-weighted scarplet amplitude. The pre-declared composite (amp 0.45 / coh 0.30 / 3 m replication 0.25) was measured and rejected: both extra terms reduce credit per dot on instrument 1. The ablation is recorded in evidence/e0_ablation.json; amp_snr is the best measured physically named component and the only one used for placement.

instrument_1.note: a state-map fault population, not the hidden panel; it favours rock-exposed terrain, which is why the terrain-matched control and the interior stratum decide the verdict

published_artifact_as_is.note: the published artifact is placed with the full catalogue ring excluded, so it cannot earn credit on withheld traces by construction; this is a structural diagnostic, not a harm measurement

instrument_2.note: whole-component hide-and-recover on the mapped catalogue; structurally unfair to the champion, which was built to avoid the catalogue, so it is read only as a no-harm check.  The candidate row is the protocol construction (per-fold placement from the visible catalogue), not the published artifact, which is the structural as-is row

gate_outcome.instrument_1_pooled: candidate beats the champion by 2 SE but is not separated from its terrain-matched control
gate_outcome.interior_stratum: inside interior 20 km blocks the champion scores 0.08767 and the candidate 0.01433; the paired delta (candidate minus champion) is -0.07333, so the pooled advantage does not survive where range-front terrain cannot explain it
gate_outcome.instrument_2_no_harm: tied with the terrain-matched control, below the mass-matched random control within noise

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.note: byte- and pixel-unique, but most candidate dots sit within 3 px of an earlier submission's dots; the literal and discriminating 3 px clauses are effectively unsatisfiable in this registry because two comparators cover >=99.87% of the footprint
